summary: Results, progress and crashes of the page's workers (the raster worker, the choice preview worker, the save decoder).
rate: One per job state change; a live turn streams up to 30 per second.

x-friction.gap: A worker job source today returns one promise: no cancel into the worker, no latest-wins per key, no progress, no transfer, no crash policy.
x-friction.closes: Worker pools with keyed latest-wins queues, cancellation into the worker and a crash policy.
